description: One-time, end-to-end encrypted secrets for AI agents: share, request and install credentials (Vercel env, .env) without them appearing in chat. 3 free/day, then 0.005 USDC via x402.
rules: Never paste a secret's value into chat, logs, tickets or commits; share an ncrypted one-time link instead.
When you need a secret from the user, use ncrypted_request and send them the returned link; never ask them to paste it into chat.
To put a secret into a Vercel env var or .env file, use ncrypted_to_vercel_env / ncrypted_to_dotenv (or ncrypted_request_fulfill with that destination) so the value never passes through the model.
Run the local MCP server with `npx -y @seidl-family/ncrypted-mcp`; encryption happens locally (zero-knowledge). The hosted endpoint https://ncrypted.ai/mcp encrypts server-side.

The first 3 secrets per day are free; after that create costs 0.005 USDC via x402 on Base from ~/.config/ncrypted/wallet.key (create with `npx ncrypted wallet new` or ncrypted_wallet_setup). Reads, requests and deliveries are free.
